---
title: "CSS Generic Font Family Test"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'font: \("[^"]+"'
          - 'codefont: \("[^"]+"'
        -
          - '(font|codefont): \([^)]*"(sans-serif|monospace)"'
---

Typst has no CSS generic font families, so a brand family such as
`Roboto, sans-serif` must not pass the keyword through (Typst would warn
`unknown font family`). Each generic is replaced by the first available font
from a candidate list. Which font wins differs per machine, so the test only
asserts that a concrete family is emitted and no keyword reaches the `.typ`;
the default warning gate covers the absence of the Typst warning.
